column3: Saori Route ・ Contact at the Park
Yes?
Ohhhhhhhhhhhhhh?!
M-May I know who is thisssss?!
She looks like Saori, but she's not Saori!
Because there's no swirly glasses!!
Er, erm...
Wait, calm down, Kyousuke.
Although she's not wearing the swirly glasses, she has Saori's height, clothes and feel...?
Could it be that... you're Saori's doppelganger?!
Kyo-Kyousuke-san, calm down please. I am... Saori.
*gasp*
Oh, so it's Saori.
How rude! What is this!
Are thou trying to say that the glass-less me is a fake?
No, it's not like that... Just that it's been a long time since I've seen your real face.
I can't just blurt out:
Saori without glasses is so beautiful that my heart couldn't take it!
...right in front of the person herself.
Well, putting that aside, what I want to ask is...
